excerpt: The Federal Reserve's meeting calendars are available on its monetary policy page. The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meets regularly to set monetary policy. The latest FOMC meeting schedule is on the Federal Reserve's website.

content.introduction: The Federal Reserve's meeting calendars are available on its monetary policy page. The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meets regularly to set monetary policy. The latest FOMC meeting schedule is on the Federal Reserve's website.
